sql: select count(*) from documents where filename in ('tiep_nhan_scan.pdf', 'nhan_mat_ong.png') and status = 'pending_review' and text_source = 'ocr' and ocr_engine = 'paddleocr-2.x/latin_PP-OCRv3' and pii_flag is not null and verified_by is null
select doc_type || '|' || pages from documents where filename = 'tiep_nhan_scan.pdf'
select doc_type || '|' || pages from documents where filename = 'nhan_mat_ong.png'
select count(*) from document_fields f join documents d using (sha256) where d.filename = 'tiep_nhan_scan.pdf' and f.field = 'so_giay' and f.value ~* '^123/2026/[ĐÐD]KSP$' and not f.verified
select count(*) from document_fields f join documents d using (sha256) where d.filename in ('tiep_nhan_scan.pdf', 'nhan_mat_ong.png') and f.verified
select count(*) from document_fields f join documents d using (sha256) where d.filename = 'nhan_mat_ong.png'
